name: equivalence-full-target
description: Opt-in full-target reference/candidate envelope on explicitly selected prepared analysis units.
limitations: This profile verifies computational equivalence and measures engineering cost; it does not estimate biological accuracy.
Every expression gene is inferred as a target without passing target-list, using 250 trees and checkpointing.
One warm-up pair plus four measured pairs means ten complete SPATHI executions per selected dataset and may require days.
Run exactly one explicitly selected dataset first, only after smoke and progressive profiles succeed.
The disk preflight assumes maximally dense networks and retained reference/candidate outputs for every failed comparison; measured peaks remain sampled lower bounds.

cases.description: All expression genes, 250 trees, and checkpointing on one explicitly selected real analysis unit.
